FN-TBBL315-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 346
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Paul W. Lee
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/03/2025
House Bill 346 as introduced could decrease receipts to the State Board of Medical Examiners
by $300 annually for each physician who would be certified for the existing Retired Senior
Volunteer Program under the provisions of this bill and would forego full licensure.
